The first woman to climb the mountain was Banoo Khosrawy. ""Shir Kuh"" or ""Shirkuh"" is formed of two words: ""sher"" in Middle Persian or ""shir"" in Modern Persian means ""lion"", and ""kof"" in Middle Persian or ""kuh"" in Modern Persian means ""mountain"". per_document.document: (Title: Aleksandr Krymov) Aleksandr Krymov Aleksandr Mikhailovich Krymov (October 23, 1871—August 31, 1917, ) was a Russian Imperial Lieutenant General, a military commander of Russo-Japanese War, World War I, and Russian Revolution times. On April 4, 1917, he was appointed acting commander of the 3rd Cavalry Corps, which included the Savage Division. He refused to accept the appointment of Military Minister by the Russian Provisional Government. On August 24, 1917 Commander-in-Chief Lavr Kornilov appointed Krymov commander of the detached Petrograd Army (отдельная Петроградская армия ) to secure the Russian capital of Petrograd. Krymov was part of the nobility of the Warsaw Governorate. Krymov
